about_the_game:
Health Warning: As you immerse yourself in the intense atmosphere of «Echoes in the White», keep in mind that some visual effects (including sudden flashes of light) may pose a risk to players with photosensitive epilepsy. We recommend that you be careful.

«Echoes in the White» is a first-person indie horror film set in an old Soviet apartment. The game pays special attention to the creepy atmosphere and deep plot.

Once upon a time, an exemplary family of three lived here: a father, a mother and their ten-year-old son. But this family suffered a terrible fate. You will have to find out all the dark secrets of what happened, taking on the role of the very son who left the family nest after the tragedy.

You tried to move on, and it seemed to you that a new, "white streak" of life had come. However, on an unremarkable day, something forces you to return to the empty lair of the past. And here something... inexplicable begins to happen?

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains scenes that may be undesirable for certain age groups: elements of violence, images of blood, as well as themes related to substance use. We recommend that players evaluate the content's age and personal sensitivity and rationally limit the game's audience.

short_description: «Echoes in the White» is a psychological horror from the first person. Return to the apartment of your childhood to uncover the dark secret of the family. The action takes place 10 years later. A creepy and tense atmosphere, a deep plot and riddles - all this awaits you in this game.
